sources.title: SCARP: 3D Shape Completion in ARbitrary Poses for Improved Grasping
sources.snippet: We propose SCARP, a model that performs Shape Completion in ARbitrary Poses. Given a partial pointcloud of an object, SCARP learns a disentangled feature representation of pose and shape by relying on rotationally equivariant pose features and geometric shape features trained using a multi-tasking objective.
